beginnerHint.title: Start from a sound
beginnerHint.stepStudio1c: . Turn off “Make editable notes” beside Import audio if you want original audio only. Double-click a note clip in the library to edit.
beginnerHint.setupPreamble: Skip this section if uploads and playback already work.
beginnerHint.step1: In the repo root, run setup once:
beginnerHint.advancedFallback: Advanced fallback: python scripts/beginner_preflight.py then python scripts/beginner_launch.py
beginnerHint.checklistNote: Longer setup doc: docs/BEGINNER_FIRST_RUN_CHECKLIST.md. Advanced path (optional): python scripts/beginner_launch.py
beginnerHint.readinessPrefix: Local setup may not be ready yet:
beginnerHint.readinessFetchFailed: Could not reach local health check. Start with beginner_launch.bat, then refresh.
beginnerHint.entryHelpTitle: Open first-run checklist and tips (same as More help)
beginnerHint.helpL1: Windows first run (repo root): beginner_setup.bat — prepares venv and Python packages.
beginnerHint.helpL2: Launch Studio/API: beginner_launch.bat (opens Studio when ready).
beginnerHint.helpL3: In Studio: Import audio (with “Make editable notes” on by default) or Record; double-click a note clip to edit.
beginnerHint.helpF1: Missing SoundFont: add a .sf2 under assets/ (default assets/piano.sf2).
beginnerHint.helpF2: Port in use or bind error: stop other servers or change PORT in .env.
beginnerHint.helpF3: First pip install is slow: large ML/audio dependencies are expected.
beginnerHint.helpDocNote: The full checklist file lives in your repo clone: docs/BEGINNER_FIRST_RUN_CHECKLIST.md
beginnerHint.cloudStep1: Click Record at the top and hum a melody, or use Import audio to upload a recording.
beginnerHint.cloudStep2: Wait a moment. The recording becomes a note clip in the library on the left.
beginnerHint.cloudStep3: Double-click the clip to open the editor, fix notes or change instruments, then click Save at the top.
beginnerHint.helpCloudRetry: If conversion fails, make sure the recording is clear with no backing music, check your remaining credits, and try again.

editor.helpStep1: 1) Click empty grid: set cursor and choose a cell.
editor.helpStep2: 2) Press Insert Note: add a default note at the selected cell.
editor.helpStep3: 3) Click a note: select; drag to move; drag the right edge to resize.
editor.helpStep5: 5) Velocity lane (below grid): drag bars to set velocity (1-127); Shift for fine adjustment.
editor.helpStep6: 6) Drag on empty grid (or ▭ tool) to box-select notes; then Copy/Paste/Extract/Duplicate.
